title: Lazy E is making a name for himself in the music scene
htmlContent:
Talented Lyrical genius, Lazy E is a talented high-octane performing artist with hard-hitting bars over organic sonic textures who is currently making massive waves with the release of his recent track "Nobody But Us." Lazy E's talents are on full display in this current track where he holds nothing back as he delivers the song.

Lazy E's "Nothing But Us" is a heartfelt hip-hop song based on a real story; every real story has a beginning, middle, and ending. The song has excellent momentum even without a hook, making you forget it's 4 minutes long, which keeps his ever-growing fans returning for more.
